diagnosis: HPV-associated vulvar squamous cell carcinoma, basaloid type

legend: HPV-associated vulvar squamous cell carcinoma with mixed basaloid and keratinizing features. The tumour consists of irregularly shaped nests composed of poorly organized, immature, undifferentiated cells that resemble high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion, showing frequent mitotic figures. There are foci of keratinization. Abundant melanophages are seen on the left.
The tumoural cells shows strong and diffuse, cytoplasmic and nuclear block-type positivity for p16. p16 is typically overexpressed in HPV-associated vulvar squamous cell carcinomas.

diagnosis: HPV-associated vulvar squamous cell carcinoma with a keratinizing pattern
legend: About one third of HPV-associated vulvar squamous cell carcinomas show this unusual pattern.
